hero.eyebrow: Unduna wa Zaumoyo · Chithandizo cha AI
hero.subtitle: Lowetsani zizindikiro zanu ndi kupeza chithandizo cha AI mwamsanga. Mu Chingerezi kapena Chichewa, pa foni iliyonse — palibe pulogalamu yofunika.

how.label: Mmene zimagwira
how.title: Masitepe atatu a chithandizo
how.subtitle: Zopangidwira kumveka bwino ndi mwachangu pa chipangizo chilichonse.
how.step1_desc: Sankhani m'ndandanda wa zizindikiro zodziwika bwino mu Chingerezi kapena Chichewa.
how.step2_desc: Modeli yathu imayerekeza zizindikiro zanu ndi mitundu ya matenda 15 ofunika kwambiri ku Malawi.
how.step3_desc: Onani matenda otheka ndi kukhulupirika kwake, pamodzi ndi malangizo a kupewa ndi chisamaliro.

diseases.label: Kufikira kwa matenda
diseases.title: Yophunzitsidwa pa matenda ofunika ku Malawi
diseases.subtitle: Modeli yotsimikizika pa matenda omwe ali ndi vuto lalikulu m'dziko.
diseases.note: Zotsatira ndi chitsogozo chabe ndipo sizilowa m'malo mwa kuyeza kwa dokotala.

ussd.label: Njira zambiri
ussd.title: Mulibe smartphone? Palibe vuto.
ussd.subtitle: Imbani nambala ya USSD pa foni iliyonse kuti mugwiritse ntchito ntchito yomweyi — palibe intaneti, palibe data, palibe pulogalamu.
ussd.feature1: Imagwira pa netiweki iliyonse ya GSM

features.label: Zomwe dongosolo limatha
features.title: Zopangidwira Malawi
features.ai_desc: Yophunzitsidwa pa zizindikiro za matenda ofunika ku Malawi pogwiritsa ntchito XGBoost, SVM, ndi Random Forest.
features.channels_desc: Ogwiritsa smartphone amapeza mawonekedwe a web. Ogwiritsa foni wamba amaimba nambala.
features.language_desc: Kuthandizira kwathunthu Chingerezi ndi Chichewa, ndi mawu a zachipatala kuchokera m'mabuku.
features.security_desc: Zizindikiro sizigawidwa. Maakaunti osasankha amasunga mbiri motetezeka pansi pa lamulo la Data Protection Act.

final_cta.title: Muli wokonzeka kuyang'ana zizindikiro?
final_cta.subtitle: Zimatenga mphindi imodzi yokha. Kwaulere, kwachinsinsi, mu chilankhulo chanu.

testimonials.label: Ma Umboni
testimonials.title: Amakhulupirira ndi ogwira ntchito zaumoyo ndi odwala
testimonials.quote1: Zinandiuza kuti ndifunse chithandizo mwamsanga — ndinapita ku chipatala ndipo ndinathandizidwa ndi malungo msanga.
testimonials.quote2: Yosavuta kugwiritsa ntchito pa foni wamba. Odwala anga amene sadziwa Chingerezi tsopano angagwiritse ntchito mu Chichewa.
testimonials.quote3: Ndimagwiritsa ntchito ngati kuyang'ana koyambirira ndisanaganize zopita ku chipatala cha boma.

faq.label: Mafunso ofunsidwa kawirikawiri
faq.title: Mayankho a mafunso ofala
faq.q1: Kodi izi zimalowa m'malo mwa dokotala?
faq.a1: Ayi. Dongosolo ili limapereka chitsogozo kutengera zizindikiro zomwe zanenedwa. Silimayesa. Nthawi zonse funsani wothandizira wa zaumoyo woyenerera kuti atsimikizire ndi kuchiza.
faq.q2: Kodi ndikufunika smartphone kuti ndigwiritse ntchito?
faq.a2: Ayi. Mutha kugwiritsa ntchito web pa smartphone kapena kompyuta, kapena imbani nambala yathu ya USSD pa foni iliyonse — kuphatikizapo foni wamba.
faq.q3: Kodi zambiri zanga zaumoyo ndi zachinsinsi?
faq.a3: Inde. Zizindikiro zanu zimapangidwa motetezeka ndipo sizigawidwa ndi anthu ena. Kupanga akaunti ndikosankha ndipo kumangogwiritsidwa ntchito kusunga mbiri yanu.
faq.a4: Modeli yaphunzitsidwa pa zizindikiro za matenda 15 ofunika ku Malawi. Komabe, ndi chida chotsogolera, osati chida choyezera.
faq.q5: Kodi ndi matenda ati omwe imatha kuzindikira?
faq.a5: Malungo, typhoid, chifuwa chachikulu, dengue, mitundu isanu ya hepatitis, kutsegula m'mimba, nimonia, Ndi ena ambiri..
faq.a6: Ayi. Web ndi yaulere. USSD ikhoza kutenga ndalama zochepa kuchokera kwa opareshoni wa foni.

about.title: Chithandizo cha thanzi chopangidwira Malawi
about.intro: Malawi Health AI ndi pulojekiti ya maphunziro yomwe imagwiritsa ntchito makina ophunzira kuthandiza kuzindikira matenda kutengera zizindikiro, ndi malangizo a kupewa opangidwira matenda aku Malawi ndi chilankhulo.

mission.label: Cholinga chathu
mission.title: Kubweretsa chithandizo cha thanzi kwa Mmalawi aliyense
mission.body: Zipangizo zambiri za thanzi zimagwiritsa ntchito smartphone, intaneti, ndi Chingerezi. Dongosolo lathu linapangidwa kuti ligwire ntchito kwa anthu omwe amasiyidwa — ogwiritsa foni wamba, akumidzi, ndi olankhula Chichewa.

how.label: Kapangidwe ka ukadaulo
how.title: Mmene dongosolo limagwira
how.step1_desc: Ogwiritsa amasankha m'ndandanda wa zizindikiro pa web kapena pa USSD. Zolowa zimatsimikiziridwa asanafike ku modeli.
how.step2_desc: Modeli zitatu — XGBoost, Random Forest, ndi SVM — zinaphunzitsidwa pa zizindikiro za matenda 15 ofunika ku Malawi. XGBoost imagwira ntchito yayikulu.
how.step3_desc: Dongosolo la malamulo limagwirizanitsa matenda omwe angakhale ndi malangizo a kupewa, mu Chingerezi ndi Chichewa.
how.step4_desc: Zotsatira zimafika kwa ogwiritsa kudzera pa web kwa eni smartphone ndi USSD kwa ogwiritsa foni wamba.
